messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT alert — GPU allocation queue growth detected in region us-east1. Queue length: 420 pending requests. Autoscaler reports attach-deny (quota). Severity: P1. Paging oncall-sre.
maya: I'm on it. Seeing repeated 403/QUOTA_EXCEEDED from GCP attach APIs. Autoscaler logs: 'quotaExceeded: InsufficientResource' for project redwood-prod-us-east1.
dan: Confirmed. New pods are Pending with events: '0/8 nodes are available: 8 Insufficient accelerators.' Pool is saturated and we can't attach more GPUs.
liam: Proposing an immediate mitigation: reroute non-sensitive traffic to us-west2 and enable model-variant fallback to reduce GPU footprints. Can deploy the routing rule now.
sophie: Customer impact check — Support reports 3 customers with elevated latency, 1 experiencing generation failures (500s). Likely ~1.2% of traffic affected, includes AcmeCorp (priority customer).
maya: Opening emergency support case with GCP. Submitted emergency quota request and escalated. Case ID: CASE-1795. Tagging cloud-accounts and eng-infra.
incident-bot: pager note — oncall-sre escalated to SRE lead if unresolved in 15m. Please ack.
dan: Acked. Implementing fallback to smaller model (redwood-7b-q8) for queued requests and applying region reroute for non-enterprise routes. Patch commands below.
dan: ```sh
# reroute non-enterprise traffic away from us-east1
./admin/reroute.sh --from-region=us-east1 --to-region=us-west2 --filter=non-enterprise

# expedite autoscaler strategy for faster fallback
kubectl patch deployment autoscaler -n infra --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/strategy","value":"fast"}]'
```
maya: Applying reroute rules now and enabling per-tenant fallback. Monitoring queue after changes.
avril: Observability update — queue length dropping: 420 -> 98 over 4m after reroute+fallback. Token latency for rerouted traffic down to baseline; enterprise customers still pinned to us-east1 and showing partial degradation.
sophie: Notifying AcmeCorp CSM and joining their 10m call. Draft customer note: "We've rerouted traffic and applied a temporary model fallback while we request emergency quota; you may see brief changes in output quality. We'll update you as quota is resolved." Thoughts?
liam: GCP case update: emergency quota raise submitted. No ETA yet; escalated to TAM. Preemptible/backfill won't attach due to our attach-policy constraints.
maya: Plan if quota isn't granted in 20m: 1) force multi-region failover for all traffic, 2) throttle free-tier ingress to preserve capacity for paid/enterprise, 3) prepare incident postmortem runbook steps. @ops-oncall FYI.
dan: Adding an operational note to runbook: runbook-gpu-quota -> step 4: escalate to platform-ops + cloud-accounts; include cross-region routing template.
incident-bot: Incident remains P1 — mitigation in progress (routing + model fallback). Next automated status update in 10m. React with :thumbsup: when you have eyes on customer comms and cloud case.
